info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Market Research Submission API
info.description: The Financial Market Research Submission API enables users to submit detailed financial market research data. This API is designed for financial analysts and institutions who need to contribute insights and findings regarding market trends. By facilitating the collection of valuable research, it supports businesses in making informed investment decisions. Typical consumers include banks, investment firms, and research organizations looking to enhance their market analysis capabilities.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new financial market research data entries. It accepts various parameters related to market analysis, enabling the user to input specific information required for research purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit market data for financial market research. It contains all necessary parameters for the operation, such as market identifiers, research criteria, and any other relevant data needed to process the request accurately.
